title: Asean targets Defa rollout under Singapore's chairship
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) is targeting the implementation of its landmark Digital Economy Framework Agreement (Defa) under Singapore’s chairship…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) is targeting the implementation of its landmark Digital Economy Framework Agreement (Defa) under Singapore’s chairship in 2027, Trade Secretary Ma. Cristina Roque said on Monday. During a press briefing at the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits in Manila, Roque said, “All trade ministers agreed yesterday that we need to ratify Defa and ensure its implementation during Singapore’s chairmanship.” READ: DEFA 2026: Three ways it benefits Filipinos “We got it signed during our chairship, which is a major milestone.
